method: Action-name-span preference plus mean chosen-completion NLL
selection: Fixed 136-update final checkpoint; complete business validation is diagnostic.
revision_reason: Unregularized sequence preference regressed on validation. Contrast exact action-name tokens to remove negative-reason wording shortcuts; anchor all chosen completion tokens with NLL. Restart from SFT480, never the failed preference adapter. No new test inference before revision.
scope: Original 124 train-only pairs plus 12 genuine-return contrasts from original training worlds. Preference uses exact action-name token masks; NLL covers every chosen completion/end-of-turn token. Prompt and padding masked. Tail projection omits only zero-loss positions, audited without truncating context or targets.
